easy.def: A word that shows something belongs to me.
examples: This is my hat.
My dog is brown.
I love my mom.

more.def: A word a speaker or writer uses to show that something belongs to them or is connected to them.
examples: My grandmother lives in a small house by the sea.
I finished my project before the deadline.
My favorite subject is science.
I did it myself.
I made myself lunch.
I hurt myself.

more.def: A word a speaker uses for themselves, when they do something to themselves or without help.
examples: I built the birdhouse all by myself.
I looked at myself in the mirror before school.
I taught myself how to whistle.
A mysterious light was in the sky.
The mysterious box was locked.
The sound was mysterious.

more.def: Hard to understand or explain, and full of secrets.
examples: A mysterious light blinked in the woods.
The mysterious letter had no name on it.
A mysterious fog covered the lake.

easy.def: Something we do not understand or know yet.
examples: Who took the cookie? It is a mystery!
My book is a mystery.
Where the cat goes at night is a mystery.

more.def: Something that is hard to explain or that has not been solved.
examples: How the huge stones were moved is still a mystery.
The detective solved the mystery of the missing ring.
Deep space is still full of mystery.
